summary: The note describes Garden City, also called Garden City Beach, a census-designated place in Horry County, South Carolina, with a population of 9,209 at the 2010 census. It sits directly south of Surfside Beach. The developed beach extends beyond the CDP's limits into Georgetown County and ends on a peninsula at the mouth of Murrells Inlet.
one_line: Garden City (Garden City Beach) is a census-designated place in Horry County, South Carolina, lying south of Surfside Beach.
key_facts: Garden City, sometimes known as Garden City Beach, is a census-designated place (CDP) in Horry County, South Carolina, United States.
The population of Garden City, South Carolina was 9,209 at the 2010 census.
Garden City Beach is located directly south of Surfside Beach.
The developed part of Garden City Beach extends south beyond the limits of the Garden City CDP.
The developed part of Garden City Beach extends into Georgetown County.
The developed part of Garden City Beach ends on a peninsula at the mouth of Murrells Inlet.
